svg.title: AI support assistant — RAG architecture (feature 002)
svg.desc: Online answer pipeline with guardrails, hybrid retrieval in PostgreSQL with pgvector, Gemini models behind a trust boundary, offline knowledge ingestion and the learning loop.
svg.text: Feature 002 · online answer path, data stores, trust boundaries and offline ingestion · source: specs/002-ai-support-bot (plan, knowledge-ingestion, llm-contract, security)
Google Gemini API — external provider (trust boundary)
Paid tier. Models get no tools (D3).
HTTP 402 at the $20 prepaid hard stop.
GCP · Cloud Run service helpdesk (one image)
gate fails ⇒ escalate: pending_human + admin draft
PostgreSQL 18 + pgvector · DB helpdesk · e2-micro VM (D7)
Knowledge base — active source + approved articles
Offline · Cloud Run job helpdesk-kb-ingest (same image) · one transaction, atomic swap
admin edits and approves → embed → kb_articles
Ticket answered or closed → Flash-Lite summary →
1. Query = masked message + subject, query prefix.
2. Top 20 by cosine (HNSW) and top 20 by ts_rank_cd.
3. Fuse with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, k = 60; keep 6.
5. Dedupe; cap the bundle at ~5 k tokens.
6. G4: escalate if best cosine < min_relevance.
Aliases only: the model never sees database ids.
Random nonce in tags: user text cannot close them.
D1 No graph DB: recursive CTE over kb_links.
D2 RAG, not the whole manual: citations, less data.
D3 No tools for the model: code builds the context.
D4 Cross-user data only via approved articles.
D7 One shared PostgreSQL database + pgvector.
Cost ≈ $0.01–0.02 per request; kill switch at $18.
Numbered main flow: post → enqueue → run → retrieve → ingest
